name: dacheng-php/yii2-swoole
description: Production-ready Swoole 6 coroutine runtime adapter and async components for Yii2.

suggest.ext-pdo: Required to use Dacheng\Yii2\Swoole\Db\Connection pooled database component.
suggest.yiisoft/yii2-debug: Required to use the coroutine-safe Swoole Debug Toolbar and SwoolePanel.
suggest.yiisoft/yii2-httpclient: Required to use coroutine non-blocking HttpClient.
suggest.yiisoft/yii2-queue: Required to use coroutine RedisQueue workers.
suggest.yiisoft/yii2-redis: Required to use coroutine Redis connection pool, cache, and session.

scripts.lint: php -r 'foreach (new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator("src")) as $f) { if ($f->getExtension() === "php") { passthru("php -l " . escapeshellarg($f->getPathname()), $c); if ($c !== 0) exit($c); } }'
